regional-terms.def: Names for areas of the body surface in the anatomical position, such as cephalic (head), cervical (neck), thoracic (chest), lumbar (lower back), brachial (arm, shoulder to elbow), antebrachial (forearm), femoral (thigh) and crural (leg, knee to ankle).

abdominal-quadrants.def: The four areas made by a midsagittal line and a transverse line crossing at the navel: right upper, left upper, right lower and left lower, named for the patient's own sides.

abdominopelvic-regions.def: The nine areas made by two vertical and two horizontal lines across the abdomen: right and left hypochondriac with the epigastric between them, right and left lumbar with the umbilical between them, and right and left iliac with the hypogastric between them.
